Subject: FintechCorp — security discovery call recap & next steps

Hi Michael,

Thanks again for taking time today — great to meet you and Sanjay. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so everything is captured: 

Call highlights:
- Discussed Redwood Dedicated/API options for FintechCorp low-latency inference.
- Security/compliance: you asked about SOC 2 status, GDPR/HIPAA posture, vendor security questionnaire (VSA), and incident response / breach notification timelines.
- BCP/DR evidence: you mentioned recent audit needs around DR tests and RTO/RPO.

Immediate next steps (we own):
1) We will share a redacted SOC 2 Type II summary and the SOC 2 controls matrix (redactions for customer data only) — target: 2026-04-14 EOD.
2) Our security lead (Laura) will send an IR plan summary and clarify breach notification timelines (to customers and regulators).
3) We’ll kick off the vendor security questionnaire — can you confirm preferred format (DocuSign questionnaire link vs spreadsheet)?
4) Provide BCP/DR evidence: latest DR test report and RTO/RPO statements (attached once reviewed).

Could you confirm the questionnaire format and any specific evidence items your audit team requires beyond SOC 2 and DR test reports?

Thanks,
Alex

Subject: Re: FintechCorp — security discovery call recap & next steps

Alex — thanks for the recap. Confirming a few items from our side: 

- Questionnaire: we prefer a DocuSign-based vendor security questionnaire that we can route to internal stakeholders. If you can generate a link, that would be ideal.
- Evidence: SOC 2 (Type II) summary + DR test report + IR plan summary are the core asks. Our compliance team may request full control mappings later, but start with redacted summaries.
- Breach notification: our regional legal wants to confirm your timeline for customer notification and regulator notification (GDPR 72-hour window; for U.S. customers we expect notification within 24-72 hours depending on scope). Can Laura confirm Redwood's SLA for notification to customers vs. to regulators?

Also, please include contact info for your incident response point-of-contact (phone + escalation email).

Thanks,
Michael

--
Michael O'Neil
Head of Infrastructure Security | FintechCorp
michael.oneil@fintechcorp.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-04-13T09:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FintechCorp — security discovery call recap & next steps

Michael,

Appreciate the clear list. Quick notes from security: 

Attachments included: SOC2_TypeII_summary_redacted.pdf; IR_plan_summary.docx; BCP_DR_test_report_2025-11.pdf (redacted where required).

Breach notification timelines (high level):
- Regulatory notification: We follow applicable law — for GDPR incidents we commit to support the customer to meet the 72-hour notification window; Redwood will provide initial incident findings and proposed regulatory notification language within 48 hours of incident detection where feasible.
- Customer notification: We will notify affected customers within 24 hours of confirming that customer data has been impacted or sooner if legal/regulatory obligations require it.
- Public disclosures: Coordinated by our legal team; timing depends on scope.

Incident response POC / escalation contacts:
- Primary IR lead: Laura Bennett, Incident Response (ir-lead@redwood.ai) — phone: +1 (650) 555-0260
- 24/7 escalation mailbox: ir-escalate@redwood.ai

BCP/DR specifics:
- RTO: 1 hour for control-plane metadata; 6 hours for model serving for Dedicated capacity (config-dependent).
- RPO: under 15 minutes for metadata; model state is non-persistent for hosted API — we provide guidance on cache warmup strategies.
- We ran a full DR test Nov 2025 — report attached (BCP_DR_test_report_2025-11.pdf).

DocuSign questionnaire: Alex / Marissa, can you confirm whether we should generate a DocuSign VSA link or deliver the questionnaire as a spreadsheet? Michael asked for DocuSign preference.

Happy to jump on a short follow-up call with your compliance team if that helps.

Best,
Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Sr. Security Manager | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0260

Michael — thanks, and appreciate the timeline guidance. Next steps from Redwood: 

1) DocuSign questionnaire: we will generate a DocuSign VSA link and send to you by 2026-04-16. Marissa will own follow-up on completion.
2) Deliverables: Laura attached the SOC 2 summary, IR plan summary, and DR test report in her note above. If you need additional control mappings (CC or evidence files), we can provide those under an NDA — let us know which specific controls you need.
3) Contact confirmation: Laura (ir-lead@redwood.ai) is the incident escalation POC; ir-escalate@redwood.ai is monitored 24/7.
4) Follow-up call: propose 2026-04-20, 10:00am PT to review the questionnaire and any outstanding audit asks — please confirm availability.

Thanks — looping Marissa to set the DocuSign and calendar invite.

Alex
